review_type: bounded original outcome-pixels-only Stormwood catalogue supplement

reviewer.name: blind_listener_f10
reviewer.role: retained original independent code-blind visual judge

scope: P2-110 loss/out-of-fight clarity and P2-111 victory reward grouping only. Independent new pixel ratings; no prior-score transfer, no rerating of the original 36 or six context rows.

visible_outcome_classification.reason: H35 shows Voltarach with a nearly depleted health bar while Sparkit's visible health bar remains green. H36 shows Voltarach's health bar empty, its body lowered/fallen, and +bond won text beside the team roster. H37/H38 show the fallen blue creature, the explicit 'The wild creature is beaten.' headline, and the Hollows Alpha/Great Candy reward acknowledgement. These visible states support judging the victory presentation, not a player-party loss.

scales.exposure: 1–5: frequency/prominence of the subject in its gameplay context

rows.subject: Hollows victory reward tiles
rows.reason: The victory itself reads clearly from the cyan headline and the text naming Great Candy. However, a colored item icon with x1 and four white cross-shaped empty binding markers form a single central row between that headline and the reward sentence. The same white markers are already visible in the ordinary HUD before combat (H01). In H37/H38 there is no clear receipt container or label separating the item reward from those persistent binding markers, so the row can still be read as a grouped set of earned reward tiles.
limits: This score concerns visible acknowledgement/reward/quickbar grouping only; the explicit victory wording is readable.
Two end-state stills expose the layout, not its duration, dismissal behavior or controller interaction.
Pixels do not establish award persistence, participant eligibility, earned progression or the mechanical cause of the result.

withheld_rows.subject: Hollows fight loss/out-of-fight clarity
withheld_rows.reason: The chronological contact views and inspected final full rasters expose a wild-enemy defeat/victory presentation. They do not expose a fallen owned creature, player-party loss, or a corresponding loss/out-of-fight acknowledgement. Green TEAM 5/5 bars in this victory context are not evidence of the original loss defect.
withheld_rows.missing_context: Actual visible Hollows loss sequence: owned-creature fall/defeat, ensuing out-of-fight or loss message, and the team roster/exploration HUD together at the immediate transition and settled result.
limits: No loss rating is inferred from fixture names, the presence of a fallen wild creature, or a victory HUD.

inspection.bar: Previously inspected approved Stormwood boards and current written ART_DIRECTION readability/UI bar; this is a Low still-image subset, not full Bar A/B acceptance.
inspection.independence: Only neutral image pixels were used; source/config/party/args/logs/receipts/private mapping/hashes/source reviews/claimed runtime outcomes and prior scores were not read.

preservation: Original 36 ratings, six context ratings and their evidence artifacts remain unchanged. This output is a separate supplement.
full_F41_0: OPEN — P2-110 loss context remains unassessed; no whole catalogue/criterion completion is claimed.
limitations: No earned combat, continuous motion, multiplayer, result mechanics, full matrix or target-hardware acceptance is inferred.
Outcome classification is the presentation visible in the supplied images; it does not independently verify runtime provenance.
